name: Hara Katsu! 2 ~Kozukuri Ecchi de Onayami Kaiketsu~
original_name: はらかつ！２ ～子作りエッチでお悩み解決～
source:
There are women who depressedly want to have children in this world, either because of pressure from family, their passive husbands or something else. And the protagonist is the head of an office that helps these women through doing a certain "thing."

In the beginning, the clients clearly disapprove, but the need for children gradually wins them over. And so, the impregnating life between the protagonist and the worried women begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=580]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
世上有些女性渴望孩子，却因家庭压力、消极的丈夫或其他原因而陷入苦恼。主人公经营着一家办公室，专门通过某种“事情”帮助这些女性。

起初，客户们明确表示反对，但对孩子的渴望逐渐说服了她们。于是，主人公与这些烦恼中的女性开始了让她们怀孕的生活。

[译自[url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/index.php?cID=580]官方网站[/url]]
